$comment: Model ids and prices (USD per 1M tokens, Anthropic first-party API). Maintained by hand. The runner, pricing engine and web read this file; nothing hardcodes a model id. cache_* rates follow Anthropic's standard prompt-caching multipliers (read = 0.1x input, write = 1.25x input) unless a model publishes a different rate.

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.notes: Default. The model the corpus measured its depths with (docs/costs.md, 7.7.5).

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.notes: About half the cost of Opus 5.5. Strong on checklist compliance and pattern-matchable items.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.1
models.notes: Highest capability and highest price. Reads less from the prompt cache than Opus on our runs, so the real cost lands under the estimate.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Cheapest. Will miss cross-file logic bugs; fine for a Quick triage, weak for Standard.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: Previous generation. Kept for reports produced with it; not offered for new runs.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: Previous generation. Kept for reports produced with it; not offered for new runs.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.5
models.notes: Previous generation. Kept for reports produced by hand before this platform existed; not offered for new runs.
